name: Wall Trio
visual_description: Three creatures in a horizontal frame: a blue geometric tree-like figure on the left, a red brick-textured square creature with stick legs in the center, and a fiery sun-like creature with sharp teeth on the right
biography: Three elemental guardians united in defense: a crystal tree, a brick golem, and a solar beast.

name: Box
visual_description: A small spiky orange creature with a face inside a teal/blue rectangular frame
biography: A mysterious spiky creature trapped within a magical teal container, waiting to be unleashed.

name: Light Combined Demons
visual_description: Three yellow ghost-like demons with red horns and orange eyes, connected by a red horizontal bar, all inside a dark-bordered frame

attacks.name: Dark Wall Forces
attacks.description: Makes every wall turn against you

biography: Three infernal spirits bound together by dark magic, their combined flames burn with unholy intensity.

name: Fog Trio
visual_description: Three fog/cloud-themed creatures in a purple frame: a dark gray ghost with a yellow eye, a spotted/dotted cloud-like shape, and a blue funnel/tornado shape
biography: A trinity of mist spirits that work in perfect harmony to blanket the battlefield in confusion.

name: Uber-Candle
visual_description: Seven colorful candles of varying heights arranged in a row inside a brown frame - colors include blue, orange, pink, teal, purple, and red

attacks.name: Shoots Extremely Hot Wax
attacks.description: That hardens into an imprisoning shell to prevent next attack

biography: Seven enchanted candles that burn with eternal flames, each color representing a different magical power.

name: Spike Wall
visual_description: An orange spike wall creature with zigzag spikes around the border, two eyes on stalks, and a stand/pole underneath
biography: A legendary mechanical fortress that crushes all who dare approach its electrified spikes.

name: Dreidel-of-Doom
visual_description: A purple dreidel with Hebrew letters shown next to it (nun, gimel, hey, shin) inside a brown frame

attacks.name: Enrage Enemies
attacks.description: To distract them by landing on W (nun) every time

attacks.name: Summon Daemon
attacks.description: To help cook latkes (splatters of oil are very painful)

biography: An ancient spinning artifact imbued with mystical Hebrew letters, each spin deciding the fate of its enemies.

name: Sparkler-Foe
visual_description: Colorful sparkles and stars in blue, teal, yellow and gold scattered across the frame
biography: A dazzling display of cosmic sparks that blinds enemies with its brilliant starlight.

name: Music-Dude
visual_description: Musical notes (eighth notes, quarter note, and other music symbols) in purple/blue inside a brown frame

attacks.name: Puts All Babies That Are Nearby To Sleep

defenses.name: Cannot Be Damaged While In "Singing" Form

biography: A melodic spirit whose haunting songs can either soothe or shatter the minds of those who listen.

name: Electric Spike Wall
visual_description: A yellow electric spike wall with zigzag lightning patterns around the border, three eyes, and electricity effects inside a brown and yellow frame
biography: A living fortress of crackling lightning and razor-sharp spikes that guards the cosmic gates.

name: Guac Globber
visual_description: A green and blue amorphous blob creature with swirling patterns, resembling guacamole
biography: An amorphous blob of magical guacamole that smothers its enemies in creamy doom.

name: Universe Spike Wall
visual_description: A gray/silver spike wall with zigzag spikes around the border, two red glowing eyes, and a pole/stand underneath
biography: A cosmic defender whose spikes are forged from the very fabric of space-time.

name: Water Spike Wall
visual_description: A blue water-themed spike wall with zigzag spikes in blue and orange around the border, three eyes, and a pole underneath
biography: An aquatic fortress that combines crushing waves with piercing spikes.

name: Lego Wall
visual_description: A colorful wall made of interlocking Lego-style bricks in red, blue, yellow, and green
biography: A colorful construction of interlocking magical bricks that builds itself higher with each battle.

name: Fire Spike Wall
visual_description: An orange and red fire-themed spike wall with zigzag flames around the border, two eyes, and a pole underneath
biography: A blazing barrier of molten metal and searing flames that incinerates all attackers.

name: Sweet Pea Shooter
visual_description: A green pea pod with four cute smiling pea faces inside, surrounded by colorful confetti/sparkles
biography: Four adorable pea siblings who weaponize their cuteness while launching explosive seed pods.

name: Snail Trail
visual_description: A colorful snail with a pink, purple, yellow and orange spiral shell, olive green body, and a wavy slime trail behind it
biography: A psychedelic snail that leaves trails of disorienting slime and blinding neon spirals.

name: Plant Spike Wall
visual_description: A green plant-themed spike wall with zigzag vine/leaf patterns around the border, three eyes, and a green pole underneath
biography: A living fortress of thorny vines and mechanical gears that grows stronger with each sunrise.

name: Earth Spike Wall
visual_description: A brown/earth-toned spike wall with zigzag rock/earth patterns in brown, orange and yellow around the border, three eyes, and a brown pole underneath
biography: A mountain of mechanical might, with rocky spikes that can trigger devastating earthquakes.

name: Galaxy Black Hole
visual_description: A massive swirling spiral galaxy consuming everything, dark black hole center with intense gravitational pull, stars and cosmic debris being pulled inward, deep space colors of purple blue and orange, fills the entire frame edge to edge, no background visible, cosmic horror scale
biography: An all-consuming cosmic horror that devours stars and bends reality to its will.

name: Flame Shifter
visual_description: An amorphous red and yellow flame-like or lava creature with a dark center
biography: An ever-shifting creature of living flame that morphs between shapes.

name: Innercore Monster
visual_description: A chaotic teal/dark blue scribbled creature inside a purple frame with orange cloud-like shapes around it

attacks.name: Transmogrify
attacks.description: Transforms any creature into another form

biography: A chaotic entity from the depths of a dying star, wielding the power to warp time itself.

name: Deadly Top Hat
visual_description: A tiny red creature with eyes peeking out from inside a large red rectangular frame (representing a top hat)

attacks.name: Top Haunt
attacks.description: Destroys the top of your body

attacks.name: Annoying Laughter
attacks.description: HEHAHEHEHAHAHEHA HAHA HE HAHE HO HA HE HE HA HO HO HO HE HE HO

biography: A mischievous creature hiding within an oversized hat, its laughter driving enemies to madness.

name: The Summerween Trickster
visual_description: A large purple/dark creature with a jack-o-lantern-like face and hat, flanked by two scarecrow-like figures on poles, one with a top hat. The entire scene is drawn in red and purple tones
biography: A festive fiend that punishes those who disrespect the sacred candy holiday.

name: Miniature Mini
visual_description: A complex creature with multiple colorful components including a red/blue circular eye or core, green serpentine body parts, multiple small creatures or appendages in orange, blue, green, and yellow colors attached by tentacle-like connections, with black and yellow elements shooting outward
biography: A bizarre amalgamation of colorful creatures fused into one unpredictable being.

name: Infinite Duo
visual_description: Two connected creatures - a rainbow-striped ghost with zigzag teeth on the left, connected to a pink infinity-symbol shaped brain creature on the right. The ghost has horizontal rainbow stripes (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple) and round eyes

attacks.name: Infinity Burst
attacks.description: Unleashes a blast of infinite energy

biography: A legendary fusion of rainbow ghost and cosmic brain, wielding infinite arcane power.

name: Earthquake
visual_description: A spiky robotic or mechanical creature with a yellow face, multiple red spherical nodes on antenna-like protrusions, gray metallic body with colorful chest elements (blue, purple, rainbow), surrounded by an orange swirling energy mass or explosion
biography: A seismic titan that shakes the very foundations of reality with its thunderous movements.

name: Stink Flower
visual_description: A colorful flower creature with a purple and yellow petal formation, magenta/pink center, surrounded by various abstract patterns including blue angular shapes, green wavy lines, pink waves, orange dots, and teal/green spirals
biography: A beautiful yet foul-smelling blossom that weaponizes its noxious perfume.

name: Poison Shooter
visual_description: A green reptilian or dragon-like creature with multiple gray spherical eyes, an orange and blue circular core on its body, red wavy aura surrounding it, lying horizontally with stick-like limbs
biography: A venomous reptilian creature with multiple eyes that never misses its toxic target.

name: Shield Attack
visual_description: A ghost-like creature shaped like a rounded arch or dome with a multi-colored rainbow exterior (red, green, blue, yellow segments), gray/dark interior with a face showing dark eyes and yellow lightning bolt-shaped teeth
biography: A rainbow-armored ghost whose defense is its greatest offense.

name: Fog Devastator
visual_description: A dark, shadowy lurker creature with a gray/black body against a red and orange/yellow background split diagonally. The creature has a rounded shape with sharp teeth at the bottom and appears ominous

attacks.name: Void Strike
attacks.description: Channels the power of infinite space into a single devastating blow

biography: A shadowy predator that lurks within dense fog, waiting to strike with devastating force.

name: Spectral Raven
visual_description: A teal/blue bird-like ghost creature on a platform or ladder structure, with a beak and round eye, with orange/yellow and blue ghost-like figures hanging below it like appendages or minions

defenses.name: Spectral Deflection
defenses.description: Redirects attacks through the spirit realm

biography: An evolved spirit that commands lesser ghosts from its perch, striking with spectral precision.

name: Universe Elemental
visual_description: Two connected dark space-themed ghost creatures, black with colorful dots representing stars (yellow, red, orange, green, blue), each with yellow square eyes. They appear to be holding hands or connected in the middle
biography: Twin cosmic spirits that hold the power of the stars within their connected forms.

name: Ultra Fire Fog Lurker
visual_description: A fire-themed ghost creature made of orange and red colors with lava-like vein patterns throughout its body, a small red eye, and a beak-like protrusion. The creature has a dripping, molten appearance
biography: A molten phantom that drifts through ash and smoke, leaving destruction in its wake.

name: Pacifier Shooter
visual_description: A green mechanical or reptilian creature with spiky back, a pink eye, a wheel, shooting pink pacifier-shaped projectiles. The background has rainbow-colored zigzag patterns (yellow, orange, pink, blue, green, purple)
biography: A mechanical beast that silences enemies with its pacifying projectiles.

name: Upside Down Rainbow Ghost
visual_description: An inverted rainbow-colored ghost with flame-like spikes pointing upward in multiple colors (green, blue, purple, red, orange, yellow, pink), with green circular eyes and a curved mouth, appearing upside down
biography: An inverted spirit of prismatic flames whose disorienting appearance confuses all who see it.

name: Venomous Pachyderm
visual_description: An elephant-shaped creature outlined in orange/red dotted lines with a gray eye, green plant-like growths on its back, and a blue heart shape with orange pattern on its side
biography: A ghostly elephant that spreads toxic spores from the plants growing on its back.

name: Prismatic Barrier
visual_description: A long horizontal creature made up of many colorful geometric shapes and ghost-like figures in pink, yellow, red, blue, orange, green, purple, and brown, with zigzag spiky edges on top and bottom forming a wall-like barrier
biography: A living barrier of colorful spirits that blocks all who dare approach.

name: Hypnotic Gaze
visual_description: Two large hypnotic eyes with pink spiral patterns around blue irises, appearing to float in space. The eyes have a mesmerizing, psychedelic quality

attacks.name: Mind Control
attacks.description: Forces an enemy to attack its own allies

attacks.name: Sonic Wail
attacks.description: A piercing cry that damages all who hear it

biography: Floating eyes that pierce the mind with hypnotic spirals, turning allies into enemies.

name: Catadorable Monster
visual_description: A cute cat face with pointed ears, blue eyes, gray whiskers, a pink nose, and a small pink tongue sticking out. The face is drawn within an orange/brown rectangular frame
biography: An irresistibly cute cat whose adorable appearance disarms even the fiercest foes.

name: Confusion Injector
visual_description: A complex abstract creature with many colorful geometric patterns, zigzags, circles, and lines in red, blue, yellow, orange, green, pink, and purple. Features include circular eyes in the center and intricate maze-like designs throughout
biography: A maze-like creature that injects pure confusion into the minds of its enemies.

name: Elemental Trio: Water Lurker
visual_description: A water-themed creature lurking beneath ocean waves. The scene shows blue wavy water with yellow/orange sun or horizon at the top, and two eyes visible in the dark depths below. Multiple shades of blue create a layered ocean effect
biography: An ancient water elemental that rules the deepest ocean trenches with tidal fury.

name: Rude Dude
visual_description: Three cloud-like creatures - a pink/orange one in the center with an annoyed expression (X eyes and open mouth), flanked by two multicolored cloud creatures (purple, blue, green, pink) that appear to be releasing gas or air
biography: Three gassy cloud creatures whose offensive odors and crude behavior repel all enemies.

name: Fog Slurper
visual_description: A fog creature with an orange/red mouth full of sharp triangular teeth, blue eyes, surrounded by gray swirling fog patterns. The creature appears to be inhaling or slurping fog
biography: A misty creature that inhales fog to fuel its attacks, leaving enemies blind and confused.

name: Grumpy Brow Squiggle Mouth
visual_description: A yellow rectangular face with angry red eyebrows, pink eyes with red pupils, and a pink zigzag/squiggle mouth showing displeasure. The expression is distinctly grumpy and annoyed
biography: A perpetually annoyed face whose withering glare can stop enemies in their tracks.

name: Ribboner
visual_description: An abstract creature made entirely of pink and magenta curling ribbons that swirl and loop throughout the card in an intricate tangled pattern
biography: An ethereal creature made of flowing magical ribbons that entangle and confuse its prey.

name: Elemental Trio: Earth Shaker
visual_description: A mountain landscape scene with a large green and teal mountain in the center, smaller green rolling hills, yellow sky, and wavy green lines suggesting seismic activity or earth movement
biography: A primordial mountain spirit whose footsteps trigger devastating earthquakes.

name: Razor Clam Boss
visual_description: A razor clam creature with a purple and gray elongated shell body, orange curved ends like clam siphons, sitting on sandy substrate with small dots representing sand grains. The creature has a small face with bubbles nearby
biography: A razor-sharp shellfish warrior that slices through enemies with surgical precision.

name: Dixie Whistler
visual_description: A yellow/golden bottle or vessel shape with green musical notes floating around it

attacks.name: Song Sticker
attacks.description: Gets a song stuck in enemy's head

special_abilities.name: Musicify
special_abilities.description: Teleport anything into an alternate universe where everything is music

biography: A musical vessel that shoots superheated steam while playing tunes that stick in your head forever.

name: Syrup Guzzler
visual_description: A brown/copper colored syrup bottle or jug with a handle

attacks.name: Slurp Up Unlimited Amount of Syrup, Creating a Black Hole

biography: An insatiable container that drinks all syrup in existence, creating sticky black holes.

name: Cactus Monster
visual_description: A green cactus creature with multiple arms/branches and brown spikes scattered around it, inside an orange border
biography: A prickly desert guardian whose spines fly with deadly accuracy.

name: Muddie Puddle
visual_description: A brown muddy blob creature with two white eyes, drawn in varying shades of brown with wood grain-like texture
biography: A sentient mud pool that can trap enemies in its endless murky depths.

name: Ultra Bounce
visual_description: Multiple blue circles/balls arranged in a bouncing pattern with dotted lines showing their trajectory, inside an orange border

defenses.name: Deflects Attacks to Another Player, Including the Attacker

biography: A cluster of bouncing spheres whose chaotic movements drive enemies to temporary insanity.

name: Brain Blaster
visual_description: A pink/magenta brain with purple energy rays emanating from it, with a small pink brain icon in the title area
biography: A floating brain of pure psychic energy that overloads the minds of its enemies.

name: Technology Demons
visual_description: Various electronic devices including a TV/monitor (pink/magenta), a computer screen (green/yellow), a speaker, and a remote control (brown), inside a yellow border
biography: Possessed electronic devices that distract and electrocute their victims.

name: Squelcher
visual_description: A colorful sponge-like creature with wavy pink/purple outline, yellow and blue interior with green striped pattern
biography: A soggy sponge creature that absorbs attacks and returns them with a satisfying squelch.

name: Toucan-like Toucan Monster
visual_description: A green bird creature resembling a toucan with a long beak, yellow eye marking, drawn in light green/sage color inside a purple border
biography: A tropical bird spirit with a crushing beak and an annoying squawk.

name: Chomoghost
visual_description: An orange/red slug-like ghost creature with antennae and small diamond shapes floating around it, inside an orange border
biography: A spectral slug that phases through defenses while spitting ectoplasmic chunks.

name: Slurping
visual_description: A dark gray/black creature with spiky edges, yellow eyes, and a mouth with teeth, resembling a hedgehog or porcupine shape
biography: A spiky hedgehog creature that shakes the earth with every step.

name: Frozenly Frigid
visual_description: Blue jagged ice/frost shapes resembling lightning bolts or ice shards, with a small purple puddle shape below, inside a blue border
biography: Jagged shards of living ice that freeze and shatter all they touch.

name: Banana Man
visual_description: A yellow banana with arms and legs, simple cartoon style inside an orange/yellow border
biography: A slippery fruit warrior whose peels have toppled empires.

name: Pooper Dooper
visual_description: A brown poop emoji-style creature with stink lines emanating from it, inside a brown/orange border

attacks.name: Turn Hands Into Poop-Covered Danger Spoons
All Monsters and Ghosts Must Change Into New Outfits

biography: A stinky but strangely powerful creature that weaponizes its grossness.

name: Monstah Thump
visual_description: Concentric curved lines in pink, blue, and purple representing sound waves or vibrations, with green zigzag lines at the bottom representing ground shaking
biography: Pure seismic energy given form, its vibrations can level mountains.

name: Slithering Serpent
visual_description: A green snake in an S-curve pose with a forked tongue, inside a red border
biography: A venomous serpent whose hypnotic movements hide deadly intentions.

name: Solar-Powered Earwig Ghost
visual_description: A green earwig-like insect creature with pincers, segmented body, multiple legs, and purple motion lines around it, inside a pink border
biography: A spectral insect that draws power from the sun to fuel its painful pinches.

name: Ghost Dodger
visual_description: An abstract colorful design with zigzag lines in multiple colors (orange, green, blue, purple, teal) and a red sun/starburst pattern, with yellow dashes scattered around, inside a teal border
biography: An elusive spirit that dances between dimensions, impossible to hit.

name: Thunder Storm
visual_description: A dark black/gray creature with colorful accents - pink and teal wings/fins, yellow eyes, orange eye marking, purple jagged mouth, inside a multicolored border (orange, blue, pink, teal)
biography: A tempestuous creature of wind and lightning that brings chaos wherever it flies.

name: Wonka-Wacka-Doodle Monster
visual_description: An abstract colorful pattern with swirling lines in green, orange, yellow, pink, and blue, with triangular shapes scattered throughout, inside a pink border
biography: A chaotic scribble creature that confuses enemies with its nonsensical patterns.

name: Ice Cream Flinger
visual_description: A terrifying monster made entirely of melting dripping ice cream, multiple grotesque arms flinging ice cream cones as weapons, face features made of melting neapolitan ice cream with hollow eye sockets, body oozing and dripping colorful ice cream, creepy unsettling creature, horror monster aesthetic, mint chocolate strawberry vanilla colors melting together grotesquely
biography: A delicious yet deadly dessert monster that hurls frozen treats with precision.

name: Shofario
visual_description: A brown shofar (ram's horn) instrument with red musical notes floating around it, inside a blue border
biography: A mystical horn that summons ghostly armies with its ancient call.

name: Robo-Jolt
visual_description: A colorful robot with a teal rectangular body, orange hands/feet, purple arms, and a separate orange head unit with multiple eyes/circles, with pink squiggly lines indicating electricity, inside a pink border

attacks.name: Shoots Robo Lightning to Electrify Enemies
Robo-Voice
attacks.description: So annoying enemies are instantly destroyed

defenses.name: Robo-Claw
defenses.description: Pick up ghosts and monsters and give hugs

biography: A colorful robot whose electric hugs are shockingly powerful.

name: Grandpa Snore
visual_description: A large smiling orange/yellow face with closed eyes, rosy cheeks (pink heart), and an open mouth showing teeth, inside a blue border
biography: A jolly sleeping face whose thunderous snores can shake the cosmos.

name: Lightning
visual_description: Abstract colorful composition with orange, purple, blue, green, and yellow swirls and scribbles representing lightning energy, with a dark teal/black cloud-like shape in the center
biography: A storm elemental that channels the raw fury of thunderclouds.

name: Super Gardener
visual_description: A humanoid figure in a red plaid shirt holding a shovel, standing on green grass lines, appearing to be gardening
biography: A humble farmer whose connection to the earth grants supernatural gardening powers.

name: Double Duty Unlimited
visual_description: Two colorful monster heads connected by a thin line/neck - both heads have rainbow colors (blue, yellow, red, green, pink/magenta) with jagged teeth and are mirror images of each other
biography: Twin monster heads that share thoughts and squeeze enemies from both sides.

name: Cyclopian
visual_description: A simple stick-figure-like creature drawn in orange/red with a single central eye, antennae on top, and multiple wavy tentacle-like legs at the bottom, set against a pink/magenta background

attacks.name: Leg Grow
attacks.description: Grows extra legs to run faster

biography: A one-eyed creature whose many legs carry it faster than the eye can follow.

name: Sucking Vacuum Ghost
visual_description: A tall, elongated gray-green ghost-like figure with pointed top, single eye and small mouth, resembling a vacuum cleaner shape
biography: A hollow spirit that inhales dirt and spits it back with explosive force.

name: Flanneler
visual_description: A red and brown plaid/flannel pattern in a rectangular card frame, representing a flannel fabric creature
biography: A cozy fabric creature whose overwhelming fashion sense stuns all who behold it.

name: Rainbow Lightning
visual_description: A colorful rainbow-striped monster head with vertical stripes of blue, pink, orange, yellow, and green, with spiral eyes, black spots, and zigzag green teeth on the side
biography: A colorful bolt of living electricity that paints targets before striking.

name: Slippery Slope Soap Ghost
visual_description: A yellow elongated shape with wavy colorful lines (orange, green, red, teal) running across it horizontally, resembling a bar of soap
biography: A slick spectral soap that makes everything impossibly slippery.

name: Laser Eyes
visual_description: Two circular spiral-patterned eyes in orange/pink with purple outlines, connected by a vertical orange beam/laser, with yellow zigzag lightning effects around them on a light green background
biography: Twin hypnotic eyes connected by a beam of pure destructive energy.

name: Bounce Back
visual_description: A dark creature with zigzag patterns in yellow and purple/magenta, surrounded by many colorful dots/circles in blue, purple, pink, green, orange, and red against a white background
biography: A powerful cosmic entity that deflects attacks back to their source with devastating force.

name: Confusion
visual_description: A colorful monster with zigzag teeth pattern in teal and orange/yellow, with black spots and pink accents. A small red stick figure appears to be bouncing on a spring/coil on top of the creature, against a purple bordered background
biography: A mind-bending creature that injects chaos directly into enemy thoughts.

name: Extreme Ultra-Spike Hurler
visual_description: A spiky creature made of small triangular shapes with multiple extending arms/spikes radiating outward, drawn in light green/teal with a wavy border outline
biography: A spiny plant creature that launches needle-sharp projectiles at supersonic speeds.

name: Blinding Sunshine Monster
visual_description: A bright yellow sun-like creature with a central eye, star and lightning bolt shapes emanating from it, drawn in yellow/gold outline style
biography: A solar entity whose brilliant light can vaporize shadows and blind enemies.

name: Foglurker
visual_description: A dark gray/black shadowy creature with horizontal striped shading, appearing foggy or misty, with small jagged teeth at the bottom edge
biography: A dark mist creature that lurks at the edge of visibility, waiting to strike.

name: Elemental Trio: Fire Starter
visual_description: A fiery landscape scene with layered waves of orange, yellow, and red colors suggesting flames, lava, and heat - depicting a fire elemental power source
biography: A primordial flame spirit that ignites all it touches with eternal fire.

name: Cosmic Vortex
visual_description: Two identical colorful monster heads facing each other, connected by a black beam/bar. Each head has orange, pink, purple, teal, and magenta coloring with black spots, zigzag teeth patterns
biography: Twin-headed cosmic entity that harnesses the power of space-time to create devastating vortexes.

name: Orange Slice Juice-Spitter
visual_description: A large orange citrus slice with detailed segment patterns, spitting out smaller orange slice projectiles with motion lines showing them flying through the air
biography: A citrus warrior that weaponizes its tangy juices and sticky residue.

name: Shapeshifter
visual_description: An abstract red scribbled creature with chaotic swirling lines creating an amorphous, ever-changing shape in an orange-bordered frame
biography: An ever-changing mass of energy that takes on countless terrifying forms.

name: Doublespike
visual_description: Two connected dark spikey ball creatures with radiating spikes, drawn in black/dark gray, resembling two spiky spheres joined together
biography: Twin spiked orbs of cosmic metal that orbit each other with destructive force.

name: The Fierce Scribbler
visual_description: A colorful creature face with teal/cyan head, purple spiral eyes/glasses, yellow-orange cheeks/features, with radiating lines suggesting energy or fierceness emanating outward, inside a pink bordered frame
biography: A colorful creature whose raw artistic energy manifests as physical attacks.

name: Bucket Mech
visual_description: A mechanical/robotic dinosaur-like creature drawn in orange/yellow outlines with blue accents, featuring angular geometric shapes, zigzag teeth, and a bucket or container hanging from its tail
biography: A mechanical dinosaur construct that carries mysterious cargo in its hanging bucket.

name: Fierce Cow
visual_description: A cow face with intense expression, gray/pencil shaded fur, orange nostrils and eye rings, with radiating lines around the head suggesting ferocity or power, in a red bordered frame
biography: An enraged bovine whose thunderous moo can shake mountains.

name: The Scribbler
visual_description: An abstract bird-like creature made of loose scribbled lines in teal/cyan, purple, and orange, with a curved beak shape, appearing to fly or swoop within a teal bordered frame
biography: A loosely drawn bird spirit whose unpredictable lines confuse and entrap enemies.

name: Dirty Diaper
visual_description: A yellow-green swirled mess pattern with brown dots scattered throughout, representing a dirty diaper, inside a green bordered frame
biography: A truly foul weapon of last resort that defeats enemies through sheer disgust.
